subject.title: Playbook crashing when it tries to install homebrew

question: Should this Debian/Ubuntu installer support Linuxbrew again, and if so must it be opt-in and non-root?
rationale: Current main intentionally removed Homebrew support for security reasons, but issue comments report Linuxbrew as useful for skill dependencies and current docs still mention Homebrew settings.

options.title: Document unsupported installer scope
options.body: Keep the installer on apt, Node.js, pnpm, and OpenClaw setup, remove stale Homebrew docs, and point skill dependency installation to skill/plugin documentation.

options.title: Add opt-in Linuxbrew support
options.body: Implement a disabled-by-default Linuxbrew path that runs outside root, documents the security tradeoff, and includes fresh-install plus upgrade validation.

options.title: Defer to skill packaging
options.body: Leave this repository unchanged until OpenClaw skill packaging defines where third-party binary dependencies should be installed.

recommendation.title: Document unsupported installer scope
recommendation.body: Keep the installer on apt, Node.js, pnpm, and OpenClaw setup, remove stale Homebrew docs, and point skill dependency installation to skill/plugin documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the strongest maintainer-visible direction on PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-ansible/pull/16 around removing incomplete Homebrew/macOS support for security reasons.
